description: Run a test stage on an extension_dev or extension_start session: pass, fail, not ready (a precondition) or inconclusive per expectation. Debug-port checks: extension_start allowControl:true; content-script-injected and console-errors-empty: extension_dev only.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

expect.description: Each { assert: <id>, ...args }: background-worker-booted; surface-rendered {surface, selector?, minNodes?}; content-script-injected {url}; storage-key-present {key, area?, equals?, context?}; console-errors-empty {context?, since?, ignore?}; page-world-clean {url, pageGlobals?}; no-outside-requests {allow?, durationMs?}.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

name: extension_assert
